verdict.rationale: The CLI explicitly supports selective installation via `--skill <name>` (repeatable) to pick specific skills instead of the whole bundle, alongside `--list` to preview available skills before installing, confirmed both in docs and a runtime probe. Minor gap — missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of multi-skill selective install beyond the documented/probe examples, and clearer version-pinning docs (a community complaint about missing package-management documentation).
